--- ## Working notes (internal, not for the cell) - **Sub-pages read in full:** [wendybowkett.ca](http://wendybowkett.ca) home (Why I'm Running, Priorities, three pillars, ten bullets), /about-wendy, /updates (empty: "Campaign updates, announcements, and news will appear here as they are published"), /our-events, X @wdbowkett public timeline, Victoria News launch coverage 15 May 2026. - **Sources that exist but could not be opened:** the 4 May 2026 Times Colonist commentary "A crisis of confidence in Victoria City Hall" is behind Cloudflare and returned 403 on two independent routes. **Authorship was not verified.** Nothing from it is scored. If Joa can open it and it is hers, it is the most likely source of a tax, governance, or downtown mark and this card should be re-run. - **Not scored, and why.** Her strongest published claim — "Our 2 sqkm neighbourhood absorbed 518 new residential units/yr for the past 5 yrs with \~5500 units in the pipeline and CityOfVictoria has failed to provide any community amenities other than 2 public toilets" — is dated **12 Nov 2024**, so it is not 2026 campaign text. It is pinned on her 2026 campaign account, which is arguably an act of 2026 adoption. **This is a rule call for Joa, not for the verifier.** If pinning counts as adoption, it lands on M6 or M24b and would raise n to 11. - **Not a source, applied:** her endorsement post for another candidate (third-party endorsement); MBA, business-strategist practice, Downtown Residents' Association leadership and Soup Kitchen board service (professional background); the absence of any council record (she has none, and absence is not opposition). - **Rows put to the candidate before publication:** rows 3 (M7), 7 (M26b), 18 (M71–M73d), 53 (M80c) are the four full marks and each rests on a single site bullet. Row 12 (M34–M37) is the one comparable-instrument reading on the card and is the most likely to be argued down to Partial 1.0. - **Actions found that contradict a 2026 sentence:** none. She held no City office 2022–26, so there are no Record lines, no incumbent cap, and the challenger rule applies: 2026 plan at face value. - **Date discipline:** the campaign site is a dynamic NationBuilder build and publishes no lastmod. Every site cell therefore carries a retrieved date only. Flag if the site is edited before 11 Sep. - **Next mandatory re-check:** after nominations close 11 Sep 2026, and again if /updates ever publishes anything. - **M83** (civic access / public correction) has no cell in this 55. Not scored. --- ## INTERNAL proposed letter — do not publish **PROPOSE: B** (not LIVE). Joa applies the live letter; compute must not overwrite it.

**What the number is actually saying.** Four exact instrument matches out of ten answers, and forty-five unknowns. Where she names an instrument she names ours almost verbatim — Local Area Plans, a Strategic Economic Plan, tenure-priority approvals, non-police crisis response. Everywhere else she is silent, and the silence is concentrated in the three topics the framework is built on: the household bill, downtown order, and the smaller scored Hall. **The mean is high because the denominator is small, not because the platform is deep.** **What would move it.** A published tax path (M66), a household-bill number (M66d), any bylaw-hours or public-order commitment (M26/M27), or a unit and composition target (M6). Any one of those changes the letter materially; a fifth soft governance sentence would not.
